findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Dangerous command execution usage
 * @description Finds calls to command execution APIs
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/dangerous-command-execution
 * @tags security
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen"]).getACall()
  or
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "run", "Popen", "check_output", "check_call"]).getACall()
select call, "Potentially dangerous command execution call"
findings.hypothesis: The package uses dangerous command execution APIs

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Check subprocess shell=True usage
 * @description Determine whether the subprocess call in cli.py uses shell=True
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/subprocess-shell-check
 */

import python

from Call c
where
  c.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath() = "src/dotenv/cli.py"
  and exists(Name n | n = c.getFunc() and n.getId() in ["run", "Popen", "call", "check_call", "check_output"])
select c, "subprocess call in cli.py"
findings.hypothesis: Check whether subprocess calls in cli.py use shell=True

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Find all dangerous API usage
 * @description Find all usage of dangerous APIs in the package
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/find-dangerous-api-usage
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.Concepts

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen", "exec"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["run", "Popen", "call", "check_call", "check_output"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("tempfile").getMember("mktemp").getACall()
select call, "Dangerous API usage"
findings.hypothesis: Enumerate dangerous API usage across the package
